title: Deep Learning-Based Early Warning Score for Predicting Clinical Deterioration in General Ward Cancer Patients.
summary: Three-GRU deep-learning EWS used hourly vital signs plus consecutive-measurement deltas; retrospective Samsung cohort 2016–2020 and held-out 2020 set showed V2 AUROC .898 vs MEWS .588 for deterioration. Single-center temporal split, no external prospective validation.
